integrity: Exact analytic proof and standalone independent finite-example checks supplied; not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite connected metric cactus graphs and L-infinity arclength densities. Topological cycle-length support is recovered under an almost-everywhere positive lower bound, but cycle multiplicities at repeated lengths and graph attachment structure are not recovered. This is exact-population analysis only; historical priority for the weighted extension is provisional.
title: Unknown-density cycle signatures in metric cactus distance distributions
